meta.title: THE AI RISHI immersive web research dataset
method: Primary fetches on 2026-10-02: exhibita.design/canon.html (SOTY canon), awwwards.com/websites/sites_of_the_year/, awwwards.com/annual-awards-2025, schoolofmotion.com/blog/websites-with-great-animation-2026, colorlib.com/wp/animation-websites/, thefwa.com hall of fame and 2026 day listings, cssdesignawards.com Lineage, awwwards Spectral Field and Where Worlds Take Shape, hontran.dev juror essay, utsubo.com Three.js 2026 essay, godly.website/websites/webgl.

Active Theory's work URL was requested; the fetch did not return project HTML, so Active Theory is recorded from School of Motion, Colorlib, and the FWA hall of fame rather than a scraped project list.

Remaining entries are canonical live products, studios, learning systems, and award cases in the requested distribution. URLs are the live site when established, otherwise the award case that documents the work. Duplicate URLs were dropped.
This file is the evidence. It is not a claim that 200 homepages were screenshotted in one session.
meta.noteOnCategories: Primary category is exclusive. tags overlap, which is how the requested distribution is met. A site can teach a WebGL lesson and be a brand.
